title: On the Schauder Estimates for Non-local Equations with Drift: The Supercritical Case
summary: We establish a Schauder estimate for a nonlocal Cauchy problem with drift. The leading operator is the generator of a non-degenerate $α$-stable process with $α\in(0,1)$, and the drift is $β$-Hölder continuous with $β\in (1-α,1)$. The proof relies on a refined conic Littlewood--Paley decomposition and a one-dimensional one-sided dyadic maximum principle.
